description: A single-storey rear extension carried out under permitted development, adding extra living space to a home in Enfield.
sourceRef: Z:\Architecture ONE 2018\02 Simon Byham 3 Heron Mead

caseStudy.text: Mr Byham instructed Architecture ONE to add a single-storey rear extension to his home at 3 Heron Mead, Enfield.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: The scheme added a single-storey rear extension, submitted to the council via the Building Notice route rather than a full planning application.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Enfield Council's Building Control accepted the Building Notice in August 2018 (ref. 18/00708/DEXBND) for the single-storey rear extension.
caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
